settings.transcripts.heading: Transcripts
settings.transcripts.info: Transcript settings control how and where your extracted notes are saved, which youtube data API key to use (required for channel/playlist processing), and optional language-translation parameters.
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.name: Transcript root folder
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc: The root folder where transcript subfolders will be organised (e.g., inbox, notes, etc.)
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.name: YouTube data API key
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc: Your Google cloud console API key for accessing public YouTube transcripts (not an OAUTH token). Required for downloading channels and playlists.
settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe: Optional key for scrapecreators transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method. Get a free key at app.scrapecreators.com (100 requests free). Recommended for reliable transcript retrieval; direct YouTube extraction breaks when YouTube changes how captions are served.
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.name: Supa data API key
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc: Optional key for supadata transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method (if no scrapecreators key). Get a key at supadata.ai.
settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d: Target language code for translation (e.g., en, es, fr, de). Use "en" to keep content in english.
settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de: Target country/region code for translation (e.g., us, gb, ca). Used for region-specific language variants.
settings.llm.heading: Language model
settings.llm.info: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and pick a model. Temperature controls creativity; max tokens caps output length. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; Google's gemini-2.5-flash is cheaper, but its lower-cost tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.provider.name: Provider
settings.llm.provider.desc: Provider used for summarisation. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; lower-cost Gemini tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.apiKey.name: {provider} api key
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud: Stored in Obsidian secret storage, not in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama: Server URL, stored in plugin data.
settings.llm.model.name: {provider} model
settings.llm.model.desc: Select a preset model or type a custom model name below.
settings.llm.modelParams.heading: Model parameters ({provider})
settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom: Required: this model isn't in the registry — set context window, max output, and reserve % so token budgeting can size requests safely.
settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride: These are this model's token limits, prefilled from known data. Edit a field to override it for this provider and model.
settings.llm.contextWindow.name: Context window (k tokens)
settings.llm.contextWindow.desc: Total context window in thousands of tokens (e.g., 400 for 400k tokens)
settings.llm.maxOutput.name: Max output (k tokens)
settings.llm.maxOutput.desc: Maximum output tokens in thousands (e.g., 128 for 128k tokens)
settings.llm.inputMax.name: Input max (k tokens) - optional
settings.llm.inputMax.desc: Explicit input cap if vendor publishes one (leave empty to auto calculate)
settings.llm.reservePct.name: Reserve percentage
settings.llm.reservePct.desc: Safety reserve for output tokens (0.10 = 10%, default: {default})
settings.llm.temperature.name: Temperature
settings.llm.temperature.desc: Controls randomness of output (0-1). Lower is more focused, higher is more creative. Current value: {value}
settings.noteFormat.heading: Note format
settings.noteFormat.prependDate.name: Prepend date to note title
settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc: Automatically add date to the beginning of note filenames
settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.name: Date format
settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc: Format for date prepended to note titles
settings.prompts.heading: Prompts
settings.prompts.fast.heading: Fast summary prompts
settings.prompts.extensive.heading: Extensive summary prompts
settings.prompts.systemFast.name: System prompt (fast summary)
settings.prompts.systemFast.desc: Instructions for the llms behaviour when generating fast summaries
settings.prompts.userFast.name: User prompt (fast summary)
settings.prompts.userFast.desc: Specific instructions for summarising the transcript quickly and concisely
settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder: Please summarise the following YouTube transcript...
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.name: System prompt (extensive summary)
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc: Instructions for the llms behaviour when generating detailed, comprehensive summaries
settings.prompts.userExtensive.name: User prompt (extensive summary)
settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc: Specific instructions for creating detailed and structured notes from the transcript
settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold: From the transcript below, create detailed and structured notes...
settings.prompts.defaultMode.name: Default summary mode
settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc: Choose the default summary mode to use when the plugin starts. Fast summary mode skips timestamp links for quicker processing.
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.name: Add YouTube timestamp links
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc: Add links to each numbered section heading that jump to the corresponding timestamp in the YouTube video (note: disabled in fast summary mode)
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool: When enabled, reduces first pass tokens by 12% to make room for links. Automatically disabled in fast summary mode.
settings.advanced.heading: Advanced
settings.advanced.info: Advanced settings for debugging and troubleshooting. Enable debug logging to get detailed information appended to each note for technical support.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.name: Enable debug logging
settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc: Enable detailed debug logs. When enabled, debug information will be appended to each note as a hidden callout for troubleshooting.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt: When enabled, debug information will be collected and added to notes as a hidden callout instead of being logged to the console.
